text: No deforestation occurred on this asset after 2020. The analysis shows that while there were tree-cover loss events in 2008, 2015, 2017, and 2020, none met the criteria for deforestation post-2020. Specifically, a 0.4-hectare loss in 2021 was too small (below the 0.5-hectare minimum event area) to qualify as deforestation. The JRC 2020 reference also confirms no forest cover remained by 2020, meaning no further loss could occur. The data sources (Hansen GFC and JRC GFC2020) are reliable, with full spatial coverage and annual observations up to 2025.
